title: add VPC control plane provisioning: route53 peering, SGs, endpoints, subnets, and DNS
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: add production-ready Terraform modules and orchestration for provisioning the Redwood private control plane VPC networking components (subnets, route tables, interface and gateway endpoints, security groups, cross-account VPC peering, and Route53 private hosted zone peering/replication). This enables one-command provisioning for Private (VPC) control plane installs and consistent network primitives for Dedicated/Private deployments. Changes include new reusable Terraform modules, a thin orchestration wrapper for edge cases (shared services VPCs, overlapping CIDRs), and updated Helm values examples for on-prem installers. Checklist: - [x] Add terraform modules: vpc, subnets, endpoints, security-groups, peering, route53-peering; - [x] Add IAM role assumptions and documented least-privilege examples; - [x] Provide migration/upgrade plan and rollback steps; - [x] Add integration tests for endpoint reachability and DNS resolution in CI; - [x] Update installer docs and example values; - [x] Add gating policies to prevent accidental public Route53 exposure. Backwards compatibility: modules are opt-in via the installer variable control_plane.network.provision_with_terraform (default: false) so existing customers are unaffected. Rollout plan: land in redwood-private-installer, release a patch, and coordinate with solutions engineering for initial customers. See linked Linear tasks ENG-2104 (VPC provisioning automation) and ENG-2190 (Route53 peering for private control plane).
commits_summary: 4 commits: 1) add vpc module skeleton and examples; 2) implement subnets/endpoints/security-groups modules and tests; 3) add route53 peering module + acceptance tests; 4) docs and helm values update

terraform/modules/subnets/main.tf - multi-az subnet creation, nat/gateway attachment, route table associations

review_comments: Maya Gupta (reviewer): Please ensure the peering module has deterministic name inputs to avoid hitting API limits when creating/accepting peering in automation. Also call out eventual consistency windows for route propagation. | Avery Chen (author): Added deterministic naming via a prefix var and added a note about expected 30-90s propagation windows in the module README.

Diego Ramirez (reviewer): Security question: the endpoint policy examples look permissive for ECR. Can we provide a minimal example that only allows read/pull? Also I want explicit tests for SSM access over interface endpoints. | Avery Chen (author): Tightened ECR endpoint policy to read-only in examples and added an integration test that validates SSM PutParameter/GetParameter over endpoint; tests are wired into CI matrix.

Priya Nair (reviewer): Migration: if a customer previously created endpoints manually, we should detect and import rather than recreate to avoid downtime. Add guidance in docs. | Avery Chen (author): Added a migration section with terraform import snippets and a helper discovery script (scripts/terraform/discover_existing_endpoints.sh).

release_notes: Add opt-in Terraform-based VPC provisioning for private control plane: subnets, interface/gateway endpoints, security groups, cross-account peering, and Route53 private hosted zone peering.
Documentation and migration guidance included; migration helper scripts provided for importing existing resources.
testing_summary: Unit tests for modules (lint/validate) and integration tests for endpoint reachability and DNS resolution added. Ran acceptance tests in CI; manually tested full provisioning in a staging account (eu-west-1) including peering acceptance and DNS resolution between control-plane and shared-services VPCs.
upgrade_rollback_plan: Upgrade: enable provision_with_terraform=false -> run plan to ensure no changes for existing installs; to adopt modules run discovery/import helper then set provision_with_terraform=true and apply. Rollback: terraform state rollback to prior state file or run destroy for module outputs created during the merge; documented detailed steps in installer/README-provisioning.md
notes: This change is gated behind the opt-in flag and was coordinated with Solutions Engineering for the first three pilot customers. Security approval completed by SRE and Security teams.
